Package com.rpglab.game.game

Class Menu

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.rpglab.game.game.Menu
  • public class Menu
extends java.lang.Object
    Handles the display and management of game menus and user interface elements. This class provides a centralized system for creating consistent, formatted menus throughout the Dungeon Adventure RPG game.

    The Menu class creates visually appealing text-based interfaces with colored headers, numbered options, and input validation. It integrates with the GameDisplay utility for ANSI color formatting and InputManager for robust user input handling.

    Key features include:

    • Standardized menu formatting with colored headers
    • Automatic option numbering and validation
    • Integration with input validation systems
    • Resource cleanup for input streams

    • Method Detail

      • displayMenu

        public int displayMenu​(java.lang.String title,
                       java.lang.String[] options)
        Displays a formatted menu with the specified title and options. This method creates a visually appealing menu interface with colored headers, numbered options, and automatic input validation.

        The menu format includes:

        • Colored and bold title header
        • Numbered options starting from 1
        • Decorative borders for visual appeal
        • Input validation within the valid range
        Parameters:
        title - the title to display at the top of the menu
        options - an array of menu option strings to display
        Returns:
        the user's selected option number (1-based indexing)

      • displayMainMenu

        public int displayMainMenu()
        Displays the main game menu with core game options. This method presents the primary interface that players see when starting the game, offering fundamental choices like starting a new adventure or exiting the application.

        The main menu includes options for:

        • Starting a new dungeon adventure
        • Exiting the game application
        Returns:
        the user's selected menu option (1 for new game, 2 for exit)

      • close

        public void close()
        Properly closes the menu system and releases resources. This method ensures that input streams and other resources used by the menu system are properly cleaned up when the game session ends.

        This method should be called before terminating the application to prevent resource leaks and ensure clean shutdown.
